limitations: All full arrays remain at the authenticated evidence root and are represented here by saved scalar reductions; no raw tensor member is copied into the publication outside compact-evidence custody.

The short/long contexts differ in raw content and possible truncation as well as padding. The mask and SDPA rows are therefore a bounded applicability/dispatch contrast, not an isolated padding causal estimate.
The shared-original-primitive forecast and native consumer images are retained observations; no independent CUDA arithmetic, all-CUDA pipeline, or semantic image claim is made.
Missing fields and zero denominators remain undefined. Numerical prediction/native misses, signed countertrends, and zero terms remain published observations without a scoring gate.
The corrected uncropped token count is independently extracted from explicit input_ids. The producer's recorded count is preserved alongside it and is not silently rewritten.

retrieval.scope: Full raw arrays remain near data. Compact metadata, standalone recipes/retriever and original6PNGs only; no weight bank.

scope: A fixed same-seed short/long raw-content pair with complete shared-original-primitive forecast and independently formed native references. The short/long contrast observes padding and SDPA/GQA dispatch while also changing content and possible truncation; it is not an isolated padding causal estimate or a semantic image test.

signed_response_totals.aggregation: Totals are weighted sums of retained signed means and RMS energies using each saved row sample_count; no threshold or score gate is applied.
